-- MESAJ EKLE
--==================================================

local function addMessage(username, message, isAdmin)

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")

	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 0)
	label.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y

	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

	label.TextSize = 14
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham

	if isAdmin then
		label.Text = "[ADMİN] " .. username .. ": " .. message
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 60)
	else
		label.Text = username .. ": " .. message
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235)
	end

	label.Parent = messages

	task.defer(function()
		messages.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(
			0,
			messages.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y
		)
	end)
end

--==================================================
-- AÇILIŞ MESAJI
--==================================================

addMessage(
	ADMIN_NAME,
	"aynı serverde açılmazsa gözükmeyecektir⚠️",
	true
)

--==================================================
-- SADECE GUI'YE MESAJ GÖNDER
--==================================================

local function sendMessage()

	local text = box.Text

	if not text then
		return
	end

	if text:gsub("%s+", "") == "" then
		return
	end

	-- 200 karakter sınırı
	if #text > 200 then
		text = string.sub(text, 1, 200)
	end

	-- NORMAL ROBLOX CHATİNE GÖNDERİLMEZ
	addMessage(
		player.Name,
		text,
		player.Name == ADMIN_NAME
	)

	box.Text = ""
end

send.MouseButton1Click:Connect(sendMessage)

box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)

	if enterPressed then
		sendMessage()
	end

end)

--==================================================
-- KAPAT / AÇ
--==================================================

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	main.Visible = false
	openButton.Visible = true

end)

openButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	main.Visible = true
	openButton.Visible = false

end)

--==================================================
-- SÜRÜKLEME
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = main.Position

	end

end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if not dragging then
		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		main.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPosition.X.Scale,
			startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPosition.Y.Scale,
			startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)

	end

end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = false

	end

end)

print("SC Chat GUI aktif | Normal Roblox chatine göndermez.")

-- ScreenGui Setup

-- Drawing Objects (Crosshair & FOV Overlay)

-- Main Dashboard Interface

local FoldBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

local FoldCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

-- TopBar Dragging Logic
local dragging, dragStart, startPos
TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

local ContentContainer = Instance.new("Frame")

        FoldBtn.Text = "+"
        ContentContainer.Visible = false
        BackgroundImg.Visible = false
        
        TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {

function _G.PBZ_CreateTab(name)
    local TabBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    TabBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
    TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 24)
    TabBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    TabBtn.Text = name:upper()
    TabBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 200)
    TabBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    TabBtn.TextSize = 11
    TabBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    TabBtn.Parent = Sidebar

    local TabCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    TabCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    TabCorner.Parent = TabBtn

    local PageScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    PageScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    PageScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    PageScroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
    PageScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    PageScroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 85)
    PageScroll.Visible = false
    PageScroll.Parent = PageContainer

    local UIGrid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
    UIGrid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 158, 0, 42)
    UIGrid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
    UIGrid.StartCorner = Enum.StartCorner.TopLeft
    UIGrid.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    UIGrid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    UIGrid.Parent = PageScroll

    _G.PBZ_Pages[name] = {Btn = TabBtn, Page = PageScroll}

    TabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, p in pairs(_G.PBZ_Pages) do
            p.Page.Visible = false
            p.Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 24)
            p.Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 200)
        end
        PageScroll.Visible = true
        TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 85)
        TabBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end)

    return PageScroll
end

function _G.PBZ_CreateToggle(page, text, key, callback)
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
    Btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
    Btn.Text = text:upper() .. ": OFF"
    Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    Btn.TextSize = 10
    Btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Btn.Parent = page

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    Corner.Parent = Btn

    local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
    Stroke.Thickness = 1
    Stroke.Parent = Btn

    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        States[key] = not States[key]
        if States[key] then
            Btn.Text = text:upper() .. ": ON"
            Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 85)
            Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 160)
        else
            Btn.Text = text:upper() .. ": OFF"
            Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
            Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
            Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
        end
        if callback then callback(States[key]) end
    end)
    return Btn
end

function _G.PBZ_CreateActionBtn(page, text, callback)
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 40)
    Btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
    Btn.Text = text:upper()
    Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    Btn.TextSize = 10

local function isValidTarget(plr)
    if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return false end
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return false end
    
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not root then return false end
    if char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then return false end
    if char.Parent and char.Parent.Name:lower():find("lobby") then return false end
    
    return true
end

local function getClosestPlayerInWorld(maxDistance)
    local target = nil
    local shortestDist = maxDistance or math.huge
    local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isValidTarget(plr) then
            local enemyRoot = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local dist = (enemyRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < shortestDist then
                shortestDist = dist
                target = plr
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

local function getClosestPlayerToCursor()
    local target = nil
    local shortestDist = math.huge
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isValidTarget(plr) then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
            if onScreen then
                local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                local dist = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - mousePos).Magnitude
                if dist < shortestDist then
                    shortestDist = dist
                    target = plr
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for Steel Crossfire uses FishyUI and opens with RightShift. It provides silent aim with configurable hit part, FOV, max distance, and a visible-targets-only filter, plus an aimbot with target part, FOV, smoothing, distance, and a hard lock that welds the camera to one target until they die or leave range. A triggerbot fires when an enemy crosses the crosshair, with reaction delay and distance settings. ESP covers both players and bots — boxes, names, health bars, distance text, tracers, chams, colour pickers, a max distance, and a refresh rate — since bots live in ReplicatedStorage.Bots rather than Players and are easy to miss. Hit registration offers two routes: inflating the game's own limb hitboxes locally so shots connect through the normal path, or reporting hits directly with per-target and per-second rate limits. Weapon tweaks remove spread and shorten fire-rate cooldowns, while sky hover lifts you above the map and holds you there with optional WASD fly controls. Shared targeting includes a team check covering players and bots, projectile lead for moving targets with manual speed override, and an on-screen FOV circle. Everything created — ESP entries, module patches, hitbox sizes, and hover bodies — is restored on unload.
